Name: Unobtainable Items Shop
Author: AshAxolotl
Description:
adds a shop that sells all unobtainable items in the munant bug lair. and rebalances the spouse weapons (can be turned off in the config)

[size=5]Install[/size][list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Make sure you downloaded the required mods!
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
You can find the shop in the mutant bug lair.
Spouse weapons are unlocked when you have 8 hearts with the given spouse.

You can turn off Spouse weapons rebalance in the config using ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu.[/url] or by changing it in the config file. (make sure you have started the game once with the mod installed for the config file to show up)

[size=5]Compatibility[/size][list][*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode.[/list]
